neighbours.label: the word ' nose' (also '-nosed', 'loud|ness')
fire: After the fall, the boxer had a swollen nose for weeks.
My little sister wrinkled her nose at the smell of fish.
Our dog pressed its wet nose against the window.
During the winter my nose is always red and cold.
The clown wore a big round red nose and floppy shoes.
Pinch the bridge of your nose to stop the bleeding.
That pilot gently pulled the plane's nose up before landing.
Every morning the baby rubbed his nose sleepily.
quiet: After the fall, the boxer had a swollen eye for weeks.
My little sister wrinkled her forehead at the smell of fish.
Our dog pressed its wet paw against the window.
During the winter my ears are always red and cold.
The clown wore a big curly orange wig and floppy shoes.
Press the side of your arm to stop the bleeding.
That pilot gently pulled the plane's wing up before landing.
Every morning the baby rubbed his eyes sleepily.

notes: Card: tiny pole (max 2.0), gate-closed leak regime; peaks on ' nose' / ' Nose' / 'osed' / loud'ness'. Probe: ' nose' 0.17-0.33, 'loudness' 0.08. Near misses use other body parts.
